confidence_level.rationale: High-assurance exploratory interval; chosen prospectively and not from the observed response result.

interval_method.rationale: Direct transformation-free interpretation, already supported by qualified SMF-03 M05 semantics, and avoids introducing additional interval families.

replications.rationale: At 99% confidence this yields roughly 1000 Monte Carlo draws per 0.5% tail in expectation, reducing quantile simulation noise without changing the estimand.

seed.rationale: Deterministic phase/date-derived constant chosen without reference to response values.

primary_block_length.rationale: Outcome-blind quarter-year structural horizon; preserves medium-range temporal adjacency while retaining about twenty block-lengths across the 259-week calendar.

m04.rationale: No scalar weekly response representation preserves zero-event weeks without inventing or dropping response values.

m10_temporal_strata.rationale: Five contiguous outcome-blind approximately annual strata derived solely from the frozen 259-week calendar.

m10_minimum_n_per_stratum.rationale: Prospective floor to prevent interpretation of extremely sparse temporal strata; real sufficiency has not been inspected.

m10_max_mean_spread.rationale: Ten-percentage-point prospective materiality threshold; decision relevance only, not fitted to observed response values.

empty_week_policy.rationale: Preserves calendar time without fabricating outcomes.

multiplicity_status.condition: valid only for one global response-generalization claim with one primary block length and no subgroup/horizon expansion
